description: This Java class 'NameTemplate' extends 'LayoutTemplate' and provides functionality to format a PersonName object into a string based on a template layout. It defines methods for retrieving layout tokens, formatting PersonName data, and getting layout support, primarily used within the OpenMRS healthcare platform for name display customization.

classes.name: NameTemplate
classes.description: A class extending 'LayoutTemplate' to format PersonName objects based on layout configurations within OpenMRS.

methods.name: getLayoutToken
methods.description: Returns the string identifier for layout tokens related to names ('IS_NAME_TOKEN').

methods.name: getNonLayoutToken
methods.description: Returns the string identifier for non-layout tokens ('IS_NOT_NAME_TOKEN').

methods.name: format
methods.description: Formats a PersonName object into a string based on the defined layout template, handling token substitution and layout lines.

methods.name: getLayoutSupportInstance
methods.description: Returns an instance of NameSupport which provides additional support for name layout formatting.
